top_signals.title: Beijing Vows to Hit Back Against US Sanctions on China Companies
top_signals.summary: China strongly opposes US sanctions on two Chinese companies over their dealings with a third party and reserves the right to take “necessary measures” to protect its interests, China’s Ministry of Commerce said on Saturday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: One year into an ongoing political row, the neighbors are continuing to look for new opportunities while cutting risks.

top_signals.title: U.S. crude oil imports from Venezuela in July were highest since 2017
top_signals.summary: In July 2026, U.S. imports of crude oil from Venezuela averaged 701,000 barrels per day (b/d), the most since May 2017, before decreasing to 655,000 b/d in August, according to data published in our Petroleum Supply Monthly
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: U.S. economy added 165,000 jobs in October, way more than expected; unemployment rate slips to 4.1%
top_signals.summary: Nonfarm payrolls were expected to increase by 59,000 in October as the unemployment rate was expected to hold steady at 4.2%.
